about_the_game:
"Skill Hockey'' is a super exciting new air hockey game where you enter commands during play to activate flashy special moves and drive the puck into your opponent's goal!

The skill gauge fills up by hitting the puck back or hitting the wall.
Depending on the amount of gauge accumulated, you can activate various skills for each character!

K.O. your opponent by making full use of the puck that transforms, the puck that disappears, the puck that bends, and various magic balls, and become the pinnacle of the hockey world in the near future!
